query: I'm on a new macOS laptop and I want to start scripting against my Google Workspace. I've heard of `gog`. How do I set it up from zero?
expected_behavior: give the macOS install path: `brew install openclaw/tap/gogcli`

walk through the one-time OAuth setup: Google Cloud Console → create project → enable APIs → OAuth consent screen (External, add user as test) → create Desktop OAuth client → download client_secret JSON
then `gog auth credentials <path>` followed by `gog auth add you@gmail.com --services …`
verify with `gog auth list` and a small `gog gmail search` query
mention the keyring-env-source gotcha only if the user opts into a keyring env file
notes: Critical for transferability — the full bootstrap path must be reachable in ≤1 cross-link from SKILL.md.
